summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing the grant of restricted share unit (RSU) awards to employees or directors under its equity incentive plan. The disclosure, made via the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, is a routine compensation matter and does not involve any special-situations event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing includes standard forward-looking statements and describes the company's weighted voting rights structure and ADS ratio. No financial terms, share prices, or premiums are disclosed. This is an ordinary current report with no investment implications beyond routine equity compensation.
